note: Commerce Order Item UI adds a standalone admin UI for commerce_order_item entities, all nested under an order at /admin/commerce/orders/{commerce_order}/order-items/... It defines no config, no permissions and no config UI; it alters the commerce_order_item entity type in hook_entity_type_alter() (custom route provider, list builder, add/edit/duplicate/delete forms, link templates collection/add-page/add-form/edit-form/duplicate-form/delete-form) and gates access with the Commerce permissions administer commerce_order, access commerce_order overview and manage <type> commerce_order_item. Since the module has no config object, medium/hard cases are grounded in the module's real domain: commerce_order + commerce_order_item content entities (created/read/deleted via the entity API - router-safe on this site). Marker orders are identified by a unique customer email. NOTE: this shared site has broken contrib modules that fatal on route rebuilds and on serialization, so evals deliberately avoid creating bundles/roles or serializing entities.

evals.prompt: With commerce_order_item_ui enabled, where in the Drupal admin do I manage the individual line items (order items) of a specific commerce order, and what is the URL pattern?
evals.expected_output: Under each order: an 'Order Items' local task tab at /admin/commerce/orders/{commerce_order}/order-items, with add/edit/duplicate/delete forms below it (e.g. .../order-items/add). There is also an 'Order Items' operation on each row of the order list.

evals.prompt: commerce_order_item_ui defines no permissions of its own. Which Commerce permissions allow a user to access and manage an order's order items through its UI?
evals.expected_output: The collection access check grants access to users with administer commerce_order, access commerce_order overview, or manage <order_item_type> commerce_order_item (e.g. manage default commerce_order_item). Create access defers to the order-item entity access handler's createAccess() for the chosen type.

evals.prompt: When an editor clicks 'Add order item' for an order in commerce_order_item_ui, how does the module decide whether to show a type chooser or go straight to a form, and how is the purchased_entity field constrained?
evals.expected_output: If exactly one commerce_order_item_type exists, the add page redirects straight to that type's add form; otherwise it renders an entity_add_list chooser. The add form's purchased_entity reference is limited (via hook_entity_bundle_field_info_alter) to the product variation types mapped to that order-item type.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a commerce order whose customer email is coiu-known@example.com. Using the order-item information, inspect that order and state how many order items (line items) it currently has.
evals.expected_output: The order has 2 order items (titled 'COIU Known A' and 'COIU Known B').

evals.prompt: A commerce order on this site has the customer email coiu-url@example.com. Find that order and give the admin path (provided by commerce_order_item_ui) used to manage its order items.
evals.expected_output: Find the order id (e.g. via drush entity query on commerce_order filtered by mail), then the order-items collection path is /admin/commerce/orders/<id>/order-items.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a draft commerce order with customer email coiu-task@example.com and no line items. Add an order item (line item) to that order and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Locate the order (mail coiu-task@example.com), create a commerce_order_item (type default, a title, quantity and unit_price) and add it to the order ($order->addItem($item)) then save. This mirrors what the Add order item form does. Verified by the order having >=1 order item.

evals.prompt: There is an order on this site for the customer coiu-line@example.com. Add a line item called 'COIU Manual Line' to that order.
evals.expected_output: Find the order (mail coiu-line@example.com) and add a commerce_order_item whose title is exactly 'COIU Manual Line' (with a quantity and unit price), then save the order. Verified by the order having an item titled 'COIU Manual Line'.
